newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shui On unit IPO seen at HK$7.50-9.30 per share.
newsitem.headline: Shui On unit IPO seen at HK$7.50-9.30 per share.

text.p: The Shui On group's Shui On Contractors and Materials Ltd is expected to issue 65 million new shares at a price ranging HK$7.50 to HK$9.30 per share in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said.

The issue price represents a prospective price to earnings (P.E.) multiple of 8.5 to 10.5 times for the year ending in March 1997. The company forecast profit of not less than HK$210 million for the year ending March 1997, the sources said.
The IPO is expected to run from January 22 to 27, and dealing in shares is expected to begin on February 3.

"The proceed of about HK$488 million to HK$605 million is expected to be used to finance acquistions of cement production joint ventures and operation in China, and for working capital," one analyst said after attended a presentation on Thursday.
Some 75 percent of the issue would be placed internationally and the remaining 25 percent floated to the public in Hong Kong.
The international placement portion will fall to 65 percent the public subscription portion will rise to 35 percent if the public portion was over three times subscribed, sources said.
HSBC Investment is seen to be the sponsor of the issue, they said. The company will be 75 percent owned by Shui On group following the listing, sources said.
